scope: Independent React frontend and FastAPI backend; local synthetic-data environment

compose_configuration.kind: configuration validation, not an image build or deployment

separate_origin_browser.details: Real authentication and workspace data use the configured absolute API base, including browser CORS preflights; unapproved origins are rejected

launcher_failure_cleanup.details: An occupied frontend port causes the launcher to stop only its own new backend, preserving the existing preview

source_package.details: The local archive contains the current React frontend and FastAPI backend; local environments, credential files, business data and the upstream Vue reference are excluded

boundaries.database: Existing isolated PostgreSQL and Redis; synthetic accounts and materials only
